paper_title: Limits on Axion Couplings from the first 80-day data of PandaX-II Experiment
notes: Paper reports three distinct exclusion limits on axion-electron coupling g_ae: (1) Solar axion CBRD mechanisms: g_ae ≤ 4.35×10^-12 for mass range 10^-5 to 1 keV/c^2 (stated as 4×10^-13 in text but abstract says 4.35×10^-12; using abstract value as primary result). (2) 57Fe de-excitation: best limit of 6×10^-14 at m_a = 10 keV/c^2. (3) Galactic ALPs: g_ae < 4.3×10^-14 for mass range 1–25 keV/c^2. The galactic ALP limit uses local DM density ρ_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 (stated in Eq. 5). Data points encode the three main results: solar CBRD (flat across 10^-5–1 keV), 57Fe peak at 10 keV, and galactic ALP limit at 25 keV. All limits are 90% CL. The paper uses the axioelectrical effect (axion absorption by bound electrons) to set these constraints using xenon recoil events. | selector: text (sole candidate)
